scope: Elapsed-time frame choice, all actual visible selected framebuffers, endpoint, duration and immutable files. Not full30fps output or optical font identity.

host_monotonic_observations.scope: Host monotonic receive observations. Origin inferred by subtracting first recorded presentation duration; not physical refresh timestamps.

clock_limitations: ERB GETMILLISECOND uses wall time; this run is cross-checked with host monotonic receive observations. No system-clock adjustment is simulated.
